examples.name: Neutral announcement
examples.jsx: <Banner>Scheduled maintenance is planned for this weekend.</Banner>

props.children: Scheduled maintenance is planned for this weekend.

examples.name: Warning
examples.description: A cautionary status on the amber bold background. Its dark content means actions use tone=warning (not the inverse treatment).
examples.jsx: <Banner appearance="warning" actions={<Button size="sm" appearance="primary" tone="warning">Renew</Button>}>Your subscription expires in three days.</Banner>

props.children: Your subscription expires in three days.

examples.name: Error with an action
examples.description: An error status with a single inverse-tone action.
examples.jsx: <Banner appearance="error" actions={<Button size="sm" isInverse>Retry</Button>}>We couldn't reach the server.</Banner>

examples.name: With two actions
examples.description: Two inverse-tone Buttons in a ButtonGroup, the composition Banner is designed around.
examples.jsx: <Banner actions={<ButtonGroup><Button size="sm" isInverse>Learn more</Button><Button size="sm" isInverse>Dismiss</Button></ButtonGroup>}>A new version is available.</Banner>

examples.name: Urgent error (assertive)
examples.description: An urgent error that must interrupt, using role=alert instead of the default polite status.
examples.jsx: <Banner appearance="error" role="alert">Your session has expired. Sign in again to continue.</Banner>

props.children: Your session has expired. Sign in again to continue.

antiExamples.name: Inline status
antiExamples.reason: Use InlineMessage for an inline, in-context status next to a field or row.

antiExamples.name: Transient notification
antiExamples.reason: Use Toast for a transient, auto-dismissing notification.

antiExamples.name: Toolbar of actions
antiExamples.reason: Banner is an announcement, not a toolbar - keep it to one or two actions.
antiExamples.jsx: <Banner actions={<><Button isInverse>A</Button><Button isInverse>B</Button><Button isInverse>C</Button><Button isInverse>D</Button></>}>Too many actions</Banner>
